# ghost/suntimes

Read Berlin or Hamburg sunrise, sunset and moon times in Suntimes without GPS

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/suntimes
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/suntimes open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/suntimes read_sun_moon --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/suntimes search_city --device <serial> --param city=<city>
ghost skill run ghost/suntimes select_city --device <serial> --param city=<city>
ghost skill run ghost/suntimes next_day --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open Suntimes and initialize a fresh public Berlin profile without GPS or alarms
- `read_sun_moon`: Read native city, date, sunrise, sunset, day length and moon phase
- `search_city`: Search the bundled European places for Berlin or Hamburg
- `select_city`: Select the exact searched built-in city and update the sun/moon table
- `next_day`: Advance the displayed sun/moon table by exactly one day
